notes: NEW: sunsets with people, done right - exposed dark to keep the sunset? The real dusk sky keeps its colour while the people are lifted so you can see them (no fake skies). Bracketed dusk shots merge the sky and lights from every frame with the people from the sharpest one - no ghosts - and the darker bracket frames are no longer discarded. Daylight and indoor photos keep their existing edit. FIX: returning testers no longer see 'beta testing is over' - every new beta version gives a fresh 30 days. Includes the v1.31.4 WebView2 launch fix. Extract the whole zip before running RAWKeepers.exe.
notes_mac: NEW: LUT color grading - apply any .cube look as the final grade on every exported photo, live in the eyepiece, with seven built-in film & cinema presets (Warm Film, Portrait Film, Vivid Slide, Classic B&W, Teal & Orange, Cinema Roll-off, Matte Fade). Improved: harsh-daylight photos get their shadows opened automatically, halo-free. Plus bug fixes: the camera UI now scales as one unit at any window size.
